title: Telecom & SMS
tagline: SMS gateways, USSD codes, and ISP developer resources
description: Sparrow SMS is the de-facto Nepali SMS API. NTC and Ncell themselves do not publish developer portals, and ISPs (WorldLink, Vianet, Subisu) have no public APIs. USSD codes are NTA-mandated and consistent across telcos.

resources.name: sbishnu019/nepali-phone-number
resources.description: Python validator with carrier detection (NTC/Ncell/Smart), zone, and SIM type.

resources.name: Sparrow SMS
resources.description: De-facto Nepali SMS API. Supports NTC GSM+CDMA, Ncell, UTL, Smart. Also Viber Business Messaging. Docs at docs.sparrowsms.com.

resources.name: NTC Common Short Codes
resources.description: Reference for NTC + Ncell USSD codes (*144# balance, *122*PIN# recharge, *133*…# transfer). NTA-mandated.

resources.name: paraslamsong/nepali-phone-number-validator
resources.description: npm package for validating Nepali phone numbers.

resources.name: sachinkiranti/aakash-sms (Laravel)
resources.description: Laravel package for Aakash SMS integration.

resources.name: Aakash SMS
resources.description: REST v3 endpoint sms.aakashsms.com/sms/v3/send. Source at bitbucket.org/aakashsms/api.

resources.name: Ncell
resources.description: Private telecom operator. No public developer portal.

resources.name: Nepal SMS
resources.description: SMS gateway provider for Nepali mobile networks.

resources.name: Nepal Telecom
resources.description: State telecom operator. No public developer portal.
